title: Числа 10 — Numbers 10
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: Make two trumpets of beaten silver.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of / made of) takes the genitive → серебра.

cases.sentence: Пусть народ собирается у ___ в шатер собрания.
cases.translation: Let the people gather at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
cases.explain: The preposition у (at / by) takes the genitive → входа.

cases.sentence: Пусть роды, которые стоят лагерем на ___, трогаются в путь.
cases.translation: Let the tribes camped on the east side set out.
cases.explain: На marking a fixed location (no motion) takes the prepositional → востоке.

cases.sentence: Первыми под своим ___ двинулись войска лагеря Иуды.
cases.translation: First the divisions of the camp of Judah set out under their standard.
cases.explain: The preposition под (under) with a static position takes the instrumental → знаменем.

cases.sentence: Господь вспомнит вас и избавит от ___.
cases.translation: The Lord will remember you and save you from your enemies.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) takes the genitive → врагов (genitive plural).

cases.sentence: ___ сняли, и в путь тронулись гершаниты и миролиты.
cases.translation: The tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and Merarites set out.
cases.explain: Скиния is the direct object of сняли (took down) → accusative; feminine -я nouns take -ю.

cases.sentence: Трубите в трубы над вашими ___ и жертвами примирения.
cases.translation: Sound the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings.
cases.explain: The preposition над (over) always takes the instrumental → всесожжениями (instrumental plural).

cases.sentence: Они в первый раз тронулись в путь по Господнему ___ через Моисея.
cases.translation: They set out the first time at the Lord's command through Moses.
cases.explain: The preposition по in the sense “according to” takes the dative → повелению.

reading.ru: Первыми под своим знаменем двинулись войска лагеря Иуды.
reading.question: Which camp set out first?
reading.explain: “First, the standard of the camp of Judah went forward according to their armies.”

reading.ru: Последними, прикрывая тыл всех отрядов, двинулись под своим знаменем войска лагеря Дана.
reading.question: Which camp marched last, as the rear guard?
reading.explain: The camp of Dan was the rear guard of all the camps and set out last.

reading.ru: Они тронулись в путь от горы Господа и шли три дня.
reading.question: How long did they travel from the mountain of the Lord?
reading.explain: “They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days' journey.”

reading.ru: Ковчег завета Господа шел перед ними эти три дня, указывая им место для отдыха.
reading.question: What went ahead of the people to find them a resting place?
reading.explain: The ark of the Lord's covenant went before them for three days to seek out a resting place.

reading.ru: Тот ответил, «Нет, я не пойду, я вернусь в свою землю к сородичам».
reading.question: How did Hobab respond to Moses's invitation to come with them?
options: He refused, saying he would return to his own land
He asked for time to decide
reading.correct: He refused, saying he would return to his own land
reading.explain: Hobab said he would not go but would depart to his own land and to his relatives.

reading.ru: Когда затрубят тревогу, пусть роды, которые стоят лагерем на востоке, трогаются в путь.
reading.question: When the alarm was blown, which camps were to set out first?
options: Those camped on the east side
Those camped on the west side
reading.correct: Those camped on the east side
reading.explain: “When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.”
